notes.title: DLC ATC4: Airport NARITA [RJAA] | Released on Steam!
notes.content:
[h3]It's finally here![/h3]
[h3][b][i]DLC ATC4: Airport NARITA [RJAA][/i][/b] has been released on Steam today![/h3]

This product is DLC for "I am an Air Traffic Controller 4".

[previewyoutube=GsdpSGKND80;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][Airport Covered][/h3]
Located in Chiba Prefecture, Narita International Airport(NRT/RJAA) is Japan’s largest international airport. As a destination of many of the world’s airlines, it proudly serves a large number of both passenger and cargo aircraft. It is also Japan’s only airport with ramp control for apron areas. Operations at this busy airport are controlled through the combined efforts of the nation’s air traffic controllers and Narita’s own ramp controllers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38805577/585576712f005079dc056c3a27f35b5e9e641afb.png[/img]

[h3][Control traffic at a huge international airport!][/h3]
A wide variety of aircraft from all over the world fly into Narita International Airport. Because the airport covers a vast area, it can take considerable time to get around depending on which terminal or runway an airline uses. To prevent delays, you will need to correctly select runways and issue instructions to change taxi routes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38805577/27266af90d432af8bbc41e63438c27b6a39dfcaf.png[/img]

Gateways that entrance/exit of ramp area and ground area are required handover of control.
There often become points of congestion when large numbers of aircraft pass through. Select the appropriate gateway by maintaining a good understanding of the labyrinth of taxiways and the positions of aircraft.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38805577/1a238564f8a7c1251e64eb6dde13be0f3ad09b98.png[/img]

[h3][Key elements that liven up the game][/h3]
-Bad weather forces an airport to close! Narita becomes gridlocked as diverted planes fly in, one after another! Identify each aircraft’s situation and determine the order of priority.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38805577/9920c046f9b02bb831f41d5ad8b3268488c2e78c.png[/img]

-An unexpected guest? A runway needs to be closed for inspection when an animal incursion is reported. This is a busy time of the day and you have to get by with only one runway in operation. Then things get complicated...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38805577/5d750b86f844c936e3fa7db61b91568bab545ffb.png[/img]

-Greater separation of aircraft needs to be ensured in the case of large aircraft and cargo aircraft, because they need more time to get off the runway and they are subject to limited runway use.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38805577/8bbff6fa649b5a66c168958f8c0ebe6c2c8139c2.png[/img]

Purchase and more information below!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2670310/ATC4_Airport_NARITA_RJAA/

notes.title: DLC ATC4: Airport NAGOYA [RJGG] | Release Date: 28 March, 2024
notes.content:
[b][I am an Air Traffic Controller 4 DLC : Airport NAGOYA [RJGG] on STEAM - Gameplay Trailer][/b]
[previewyoutube=UHqGz4Ijl-c;full][/previewyoutube]

[b][Airport Covered][/b]
Built as an airline hub capable of operating 24 hours a day on an artificial island in Ise Bay, Chubu Centrair International Airport is used by domestic as well as Asian and European airlines. It is designed for operational efficiency, with taxiways functionally positioned to efficiently connect the runways with the passenger terminals. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38805577/77477b6b98e94d6f3574f394ceea8d3803d7006e.png[/img]

[b][Appearance by a “Dreamlifter” Large Cargo Freighter][/b]
In Japan, Dreamlifter (747-400 LCF) can only be seen at Centrair, and it makes an impressive appearance in the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38805577/f6f4526e2cbebcb2269c38255117babbf50365f7.png[/img]

[b][Virtually experience the hugely popular runway observation tour][/b]
Virtually experience Centrair’s massively popular runway observation tour thanks to a moving camera, included for the first time! View the airport and aircraft just like when riding the bus.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38805577/5cad217c0c375db584f7999f6dbd3c6ebd902312.png[/img]

[b][Key elements to liven up the game][/b]
- Flight training is conducted between scheduled flights. The key to completing the stages in which training aircraft appear is to conduct training without delaying inbound and outbound flights.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38805577/6d2edcfc879c40a9d411a8d8a4ffb1e03208e653.png[/img]

- Something is a major threat to aircraft during takeoff and landing. Will it require the utmost caution on and around the runways?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38805577/0b1e2123651c1d262ad682a858f1a0c20eb6fa82.png[/img]

- A runway can become unusable for various reasons. Determine when the timing is right and issue precise instructions!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38805577/29b2b26f63e046681ea064ee6536ef1a54a31bfa.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2659940/ATC4_Airport_NAGOYA_RJGG/

notes.title: DLC ATC4: Airport OSAKA [RJOO] | Release Date: 20 September, 2023
notes.content:
[b][A new airport has been added to "I am an Air Traffic Controller 4"][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38805577/53b10904becbb0ad69e0101a3a83fbb52bd5a748.jpg[/img]

[b][Airport Covered][/b]
Also known by its official name “Osaka International Airport,” Itami Airport is located in the center of Japan’s Keihanshin metropolitan area. In order to control noise it operates only between 07:00 and 21:00, but the airport’s highly convenient location makes it No. 1 for domestic flights among the Kansai region’s three airports.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38805577/6eae0e0c8ae43c61e3627e655b453df2647a3d80.jpg[/img]

[b][Control air traffic on two unique runways, one short and one long!][/b]
Itami Airport has two runways of different lengths. Runway A is short at only about 1,800 meters, while runway B is about 3,000 meters in length. Large aircraft can only use runway B and must cross runway A when taking off and landing. It’s up to you to issue precisely timed clearances to aircraft using runway B so that they can cross the runway through gaps in the long line of traffic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38805577/ea1e8b42fb3c79b12a5cd56e69b8564f47e5408b.jpg[/img]

[b][Enjoy popular vantage points!][/b]
In addition to the airport’s observation deck, the Senrigawa river and Itami Sky Park are also favorite vantage points for aviation fans. This game replicates those vantage points using fixed position cameras. This means you can play the game from these popular vantage points and replay views of the aircraft as much as you want!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38805577/8e9be2b02b9d6410ac1fc78fc8310b2fd671a2c5.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38805577/c0d4e92c626f9037250abe00b5325ba2b8d581a1.jpg[/img]

[b][Key elements to liven up the game][/b]
- Northerly and southerly wind conditions greatly affect the intersection points of inbound and outbound aircraft in the airport’s vicinity, so the utmost caution is needed when giving clearances to land. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38805577/184a1e6a4b12e77d3dd8cb60eee612d3acc406dd.jpg[/img]

- Itami Airport’s operating hours are restricted and the airspace becomes especially congested as aircraft come in to land prior to the day’s end at 21:00. What happens if all the aircraft haven’t landed by 21:00?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38805577/a7469e3a0fdd80ecd969e1f91de46509d73840cb.jpg[/img]

- The appearance of VIP aircraft and flight inspection aircraft not usually seen at airports builds anticipation in each stage!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38805577/e1eea8f8c8d49f7fcd6f12e61b4ca9347b050574.jpg[/img]

- The airline company TBA [Technobrain Airlines] regularly appears in the “I am an Air Traffic Controller 4” series. Will TBA face another string of unexpected problems?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38805577/79635dff6f5b8cf28173c3f11d01a5ddef42a7a6.jpg[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2314640/ATC4_Airport_OSAKA_RJOO/

notes.title: DLC ATC4: Airport NEW CHITOSE | Release Date: 14 February, 2023
notes.content:
[b][A new airport has been added to "I am an Air Traffic Controller 4"][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38805577/4b7df39353853724f926a882e645b2d8034cfe36.jpg[/img]

[b][Airport Covered][/b]
As Hokkaido’s largest international airport, New Chitose Airport (CTS/RJCC) handles many international and domestic flights.
At the adjacent Chitose Air Base are engaged in activities to keep Japan safe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38805577/a36af46ef79adc0bcfcf4ca75ee56b2ab49edfce.jpg[/img]

[b][Control two different types of airfields at the same time!][/b]
Many types of airplanes fly into New Chitose Airport, which is used by various domestic and international airlines.
In addition, training for fighter planes and the Techno Coast Guard frequently takes place at Chitose Air Base.
This game lets you experience the different characteristics of both airfields simultaneously.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38805577/67f5f25f62c0750393ced4509b941372c5a3ab87.jpg[/img]

[b][Enjoy two seasons!][/b]
For the first time, I am an Air Traffic Controller 4 covers both the summer and winter seasons!
In the winter stage, runways also close due to snow…
Find precious time between crisscrossing flights to issue orders for snow removal on four runways without disrupting operations!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38805577/e19916ba3367dca6fee720a1cedab43c33046498.jpg[/img]

[b][Key elements to liven up the game][/b]
- F15 fighters fly in single file formation. Take care to maintain sufficient separation between the leader jet and wingman jets!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38805577/8fb445212d998e0b0e4be73ad4c4e5599795042b.jpg[/img]

- In summer, thick fog from the ocean often hinders visibility. Immobilized aircraft may find it necessary to request a follow-me car.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38805577/e87a3bd6a7d4a6459f510acd3abf146f30dc2ad2.jpg[/img]

- Traffic controllers are transported by microbus to and from the control tower during shift changes. The microbus uses taxiways, so the utmost caution is required!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38805577/68daf387b7eb863a206df4cd3050b5ba8849e41e.jpg[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1839300/ATC4_Airport_NEW_CHITOSE_RJCC/
